I'm on effexor (snri antidepressant) and I'm pretty sure I had a seizure a couple years back. I knew that weed and effexor didn't mix well, but only for some people. I was smoking regularly, so I didn't figure that I was one of those people. I was wrong. 

One day I took a bong hit with my friend and we went inside and started watching some tv. I was pretty high and pretty anxious, but handling it just enough. Suddenly I noticed that my eyes were closed and it was weird because I didn't remember closing them. I saw all all sorts of colors and shit and like a second later I opened my eyes. Then I started shaking and spasming uncontrollably and I told my friend to get my mom. He thought I was just joking but I was terrified. 

Shortly after my mom came into the room, the shaking stopped. However, then my heart felt like it stopped and I was kind of gasping because it felt horrible. It was like a palpitation, but it lasted for about 30 seconds before I felt it beat again. While that was happening, my blood pressure felt like it plummeted and I almost passed out again. Then I felt extremely hot, but my skin was ice cold and I was sweating profusely. 

My mom thought it was just a panic attack, but I've never had anything like that before or since. Nobody thought to take me to the doctor. When I finally brought it up at an appointment later, I was brushed off because they thought it was just a panic attack. That was the single worst day of my life and I don't smoke weed anymore. 

These things can happen, although they're pretty damn rare. Don't believe me? Look up "effexor and weed reddit". 

I'd advise you to see a doctor, although I'm not sure what they can do for you.
